stem:
A swimming pool can be rented for $110 per hour. The pool can be rented for either 1 hour or 2 hours. The cost in dollars to rent the pool is a function of the number of hours the pool is rented.

What are the domain and range of the function for this situation?

options.label: C
options.text:
Domain: all real numbers
Range: all real numbers

options.label: D
options.text:
Domain: all integers greater than or equal to zero
Range: all integers greater than or equal to zero
